name: 管理者ロールで使える機能の一覧
prompt:
Recreate only the complete Basecamp Adminland Administrators section shown in the primary original crop. Preserve its 1120:567 aspect ratio (about 1.98:1), plain white background, generous vertical spacing and left-aligned content. Do not include the Account Owners section below it or any surrounding page navigation. No Japanese mock exists for this source; use the original screenshot as the authority for geometry, typography and icons.

At the top, show the heading 「管理者」 in bold dark gray with a thin light-gray divider extending to the right. Below it, keep a circular gray avatar with the white initials “AS” and the name “Alex Smith”. Farther down, add the bold sentence 「管理者として、次の操作ができます…」.

Below the sentence, show exactly eight evenly spaced feature rows in this order: a pale-blue circle with a blue people icon and 「ユーザーを管理」; a pale-blue circle with a blue briefcase icon and 「管理者を追加/削除」; a pale-blue circle with a blue group icon and 「グループを管理」; a pale-blue circle with a blue building icon and 「会社を管理」; a pale-blue circle with a blue project-tools icon and 「プロジェクトツール名を変更」; a pale-blue circle with a blue list/category icon and 「メッセージカテゴリを変更」; a pale-blue circle with a blue microphone icon and 「ボイスメモをオン/オフ」; and a pale-blue circle with a blue merge-arrows icon and 「ユーザーを統合」. Preserve the source icon circles, left alignment, consistent icon-to-label gap and row spacing. Keep names and initials in Latin letters as shown. Do not add cards, borders, extra items, or controls.
reviewNotes: LH09-0259 v001 compared side by side with the exact Basecamp source crop. It preserves the aspect ratio, Alex Smith/AS, the admin introduction, and all eight translated feature rows in order. Geometry defect: the heading, avatar, introduction, and icon column are inset about 50 px from the source left edge, with added top padding. Status: needs-correction; image-generation review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
